scenario: A dead function is stored as the sole element of a tuple literal (AVAILABLE = (vulnerable,)) assigned at module level -- probes the DECISIONS.md §5.3 narrowing's explicitly-covered 'direct element of a container literal' case with a tuple, an AST shape none of the existing L5 fixtures exercise.
human_note: vulnerable is never called anywhere, but AVAILABLE = (vulnerable,) value-binds it as a direct element of a tuple literal assigned at module level. _LoadOutsideCallCollector's _record_value_bound recurses into ast.Tuple elements at an Assign's RHS, so 'vulnerable' is recorded as escaped and compute_reachability cannot confidently return not_reachable.
